title: Filipino-Style Bihon Stir Fry
description: A traditional Filipino dish made with bihon noodles, vegetables, and a savory sauce. This gluten-free version is perfect for a quick and easy dinner.
instructions: Cook bihon noodles according to package instructions. Drain and set aside.
In a large skillet or wok, heat 1 tablespoon of vegetable oil over medium-high heat.
Add chopped onion and cook until translucent, about 3-4 minutes.
Add minced garlic and cook for another minute, until fragrant.
Add sliced char siu fillet and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Add cooked bihon noodles, light soy sauce, and oyster sauce (if using) to the skillet.
Stir-fry everything together for 2-3 minutes, until the noodles are well coated with the sauce.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
